# Security

Flint runs on your machine and can edit the folder you opened. A command runs only after you allow it, unless you have set Allow all.

If you find a way the app reads outside that folder, runs a command you did not allow, or sends the folder somewhere other than the model address you saved, report it here:

[Open a private advisory](https://github.com/kolan51/flint/security/advisories/new)

Say which version, which system, and what happened. Do not include `data/settings.json`, an API key, or a chat log.
